title: Get Started With DropChain API | Build A Web3 App
summary: Join DropChain co-founder Nathaniel Thoreson for a full walkthrough of the DropChain developer console and get started with the DropChain API.
body:
‍

Join DropChain co-founder Nathaniel Thoreson for a full walkthrough of the DropChain developer console.

Get started for free: https://console.dropchain.network/login

Follow along in the DropChain Quick Start Guide.

This step-by-step guide shows you how to:

  • Navigate the DropChain console
  • Generate your all-important API key for making API requests
  • Send tokens to a test account so you can test transactions
  • Make your first API request using Postman and the request template
  • Verify the transaction went through on the Algorand blockchain

This easy-to-follow video is perfect for getting started with the DropChain API as a beginner.

See how fast and simple it is to integrate blockchain capabilities like payments and NFT minting into your existing apps.

The video covers both code and no-code options for using the API. Don't miss the final preview of upcoming videos walking through minting NFT collections and launching your first web3 app powered by DropChain!
